paginas.texto: Last winter a big storm came to the fjord. The wind was so strong that the windows sang all night.
Ingrid was in the lighthouse kitchen with a cup of hot chocolate. Then the light went out.
Without the light, the boats could not find the harbour. Ingrid did not wait. She ran up the stairs.
At the top she found the problem: the old lamp was cold and dark. Something inside it had broken.
Ingrid called her friends. Diego arrived first, with his microphone and no idea what to do with it.
Maya looked at the lamp for one minute. 'We do not need to fix it tonight,' she said. 'We need a light NOW.'
So they carried every torch in the school to the top of the lighthouse, and Oliver carried two.
Kili flew above them in circles, because a condor always wants to know what the humans are doing.
That night the boats saw a small yellow light on the rock, and they came home safely, one by one.
In the morning the storm stopped. 'We did it,' said Diego. 'And nobody recorded it,' said his microphone.
